steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Gustav Stresemann served as Chancellor for just 102 days (August-November 1923) but remained Foreign Secretary from August 1923 until his death on 3 October 1929. He was the dominant figure in German politics during the "Golden Years" and was awarded the Nobel Peace Prize in 1926 alongside French Foreign Minister Aristide Briand.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: The Dawes Plan, negotiated by American banker Charles Dawes, restructured Germany's reparations payments. Annual payments were reduced from £50 million to a starting figure of £10 million, rising to £25 million over 5 years. Crucially, it also arranged American loans of 800 million gold marks to Germany.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: The Locarno Pact was signed on 16 October 1925 in Locarno, Switzerland. Germany, France and Belgium agreed to guarantee their mutual western borders as set by Versailles. This was hailed as the beginning of a new era of peace - the "Locarno Spring" or "Locarno Honeymoon."

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: The Weimar Republic (1919-1933) was one of the most creative periods in German cultural history. Berlin became one of the most exciting and cosmopolitan cities in Europe, known for its art, cinema, architecture, and nightlife.

steps.title: Try it yourself
steps.body: Explain two ways Stresemann improved Germany's international position. (4 marks) | How far did the Dawes Plan solve Germany's economic problems? (8 marks) | "The Locarno Pact was Stresemann's greatest achievement." How far do you agree? (12 marks)

steps.title: Exam tips
steps.body: Know the exact dates: Dawes Plan August 1924, Locarno October 1925, League of Nations September 1926, Young Plan August 1929 For "how far" questions about the Golden Years, always give BOTH sides before making a judgement Stresemann's death (3 October 1929) and the Wall Street Crash (29 October 1929) happened in the same month - this is a crucial turning point The key criticism of the recovery is DEPENDENCE ON AMERICAN LOANS - 25 billion marks borrowed 1924-1929 When discussing culture, always link it to political division - conservatives hated Weimar culture Remember that Stresemann was Foreign Secretary, not Chancellor, for most of this period (only Chancellor for 102 days) The Locarno Pact did NOT guarantee eastern borders - Stresemann deliberately left this open
